_about: Measured with tools/difficulty.cjs (a simple casual-player bot, 8 matches per mode and level). Chill and Medium are judged against the old numbers (before the Chill/Medium rebalance): their goals 3.0-4.4 on Chill and 3.3-4.6 on Medium, the bot tackled every 2.3-3.5 s on the ball, 2-8 slides a match. Hard and Extreme must stay strong.
